dict.Notele de la 1 la 5 ale fiecărui coleg p: Each colleague's scores from 1 to 5 on the 6 criteria of the appraisal form: the average and the rating are calculated automatically; you get the team average, how many have each rating (Very good in green, Unsatisfactory in red) and how many review meetings are still to be held.
